Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an advisory board for the Washington state ferry system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an advisory board for the Washingtonstate ferry system; and adding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) A ferries advisory board must be created to provide guidanceregarding the operation of the Washington state ferry system. Theadvisory board must be composed of one voting member from each countyin the state in which there is a terminus of the state ferry system.The county council of each such county must appoint a representative tothe advisory board. The advisory board may also include a nonvotingmember who is a representative of any Canadian regional district inwhich there is a terminus of the state ferry system who must beappointed, if at all, by the board of directors of such regionaldistrict. (b) The governor must appoint a person to serve as a voting memberand as chair of the advisory board. (c) The advisory board may take action only if a quorum is presentand the action is approved by a majority of the voting members who are p. 1 HB 2758present. A quorum is deemed present throughout any meeting of theadvisory board if a majority of the voting members appointed to theadvisory board are present. (d) Members of the advisory board must serve without compensation,except advisory board members may be reimbursed for travel expensesincurred in carrying out the duties of the advisory board in accordancewith RCW 43.03.050 and 43.03.060. (2) At the first meeting of the ferries advisory board, the votingmembers must draw lots to determine the length of their initial terms.In drawing lots, three members must serve a oneyear term, threemembers must serve a twoyear term, and three members must serve athreeyear term. After a voting member's initial term, the votingmember must serve a threeyear term and may be reappointed to theadvisory board by the appropriate authority listed in subsection (1) ofthis section. (3)(a) The ferries advisory board must serve in an advisorycapacity to the commission on matters related to the faresettingprocess. The advisory board must also advise the secretary oftransportation on matters related to the management of the ferrysystem, including system efficiencies and the relationship betweenlabor and management. (b) In completing the duties listed in (a) of this subsection, theadvisory board must consult with the ferry advisory committees createdin RCW 47.60.310. (4) The department must provide necessary support to the ferriesadvisory board, including relevant documents requested by the advisoryboard, a location in which the advisory board may hold meetings, andadministrative support. (5) The ferries advisory board must hold its first meeting byDecember 1, 2014. Thereafter, meetings must be held quarterly, andmembers of the public must be given an opportunity to provide input atthe beginning of each meeting. At least one meeting a year must beheld in a community outside of King county that is served by aWashington state ferry vessel.
